newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks climb in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks climb in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks climbed in early morning trade on Thursday led by blue-chip buying, brokers said. They said profit-taking pressure was likely to emerge around the Nikkei average's 21,000 level and gains could be limited.
At 0011 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was up 134.56 points, or 0.65 percent, at 20,794.47. Its December futures were up 120 points at 20,770.
Brokers said they hoped Sony Corp, which closed at a new high for the year on Wednesday, would sustain the recent interest in blue-chips and lift the market.
